name: Can I replace just my cabinet doors instead of the entire cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace just my cabinet doors instead of the entire cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many cases, you can opt for cabinet refacing, which involves replacing just the cabinet doors and drawer fronts, and applying new veneer to the existing cabinet boxes. This can be a more cost-effective and less disruptive alternative to a full cabinet replacement, significantly updating the look of your kitchen or bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, cabinet refacing replaces doors and drawer fronts, offering a cost-effective alternative to full replacement.
